evidence_legend.PROVEN: algebraic or analytic proof under stated assumptions
evidence_legend.NUMERIC: numerically checked for the named finite data

entries.title: Q6 cellular complex and incidence
entries.statement: 64 vertices, 192 edges, 240 square faces; oriented incidence satisfies B1 B2 = 0; graph cycle rank is 129.

entries.title: Curved Clifford field from coframe
entries.scope: each site with invertible coframe and consistent signature
entries.statement: Gamma^mu=e_A^mu gamma^A obeys the curved Clifford relation for g^mu nu=e_A^mu e_B^nu eta^AB; archived maximum residual 3.55e-15.

entries.title: Polar SO(3)-to-SU(2) edge lift
entries.statement: Polar rotational factors and SU(2) lifts pass finite orthogonality, unitarity and reconstruction checks; global sign/holonomy consistency and identification with Levi-Civita spin transport remain open.

entries.title: Spatial discrete Dirac operator
entries.statement: A coframe/link-based operator is constructed; archived Hermiticity residual 3.25e-15 and spectral pairing residual 1.35e-14. Continuum consistency and doubling control are open.

entries.title: Covariant Wilson graph Laplacian
entries.scope: unitary links and nonnegative edge weights
entries.statement: Quadratic-form representation implies positivity and Hermiticity; block gauge covariance follows from link transformation. Finite archived covariance residual 6.86e-15.

entries.title: Euclidean Wilson convention correction
entries.scope: specified periodic symbol and operator convention
entries.statement: For Hermitian spatial D0, the overlap Euclidean kernel uses i D0 + W; the legacy D0 + W symbol has an additional accidental zero in the stated one-dimensional test.

entries.title: Wilson scaling window
entries.statement: For r(a)=r0(a/L)^alpha, the joint consistency and corner-decoupling window is -1 < alpha < 1.

entries.title: Flat periodic-torus Mosco prototype
entries.scope: flat periodic torus and explicitly stated common-Hilbert/Fourier assumptions
entries.statement: Liminf and recovery are established for the documented flat model; this is not a Mosco proof for curved RGS-Q6 refinements.

entries.title: Combinatorial Dirac-Kahler operator
entries.statement: On C0 direct-sum C1 direct-sum C2, D=d+d* has square equal to the block Hodge Laplacian and anticommutes with degree parity.

entries.title: Finite overlap Ginsparg-Wilson identity
entries.scope: finite gamma5-Hermitian kernel with nonzero Hermitian-kernel gap
entries.statement: The sign-function overlap construction satisfies the Ginsparg-Wilson relation under the stated hypotheses; archived Q6 residual 3.27e-14.

entries.title: Finite overlap locality diagnostics
entries.scope: one archived Q6 matrix and sampled rho values
entries.statement: Distance-binned block norms decrease in the archived matrix; uniform exponential locality on a refinement family is not established.

entries.title: Finite Mobius spectral thermodynamics
entries.statement: Partition functions and correlation-spectrum entropies are evaluated for the finite reference data; Hawking temperature and physical horizon interpretation remain model assumptions.

entries.title: Geometric equivariance constraints
entries.scope: standard equivariant-map theorems plus partial Q6 implementation
entries.statement: Intertwiner and invariant-kernel conditions are standard; the metric-preserving automorphism subgroup, complete kernel basis, global atlas/cocycle and transitivity claims remain unfinished.

mosco_curved_program.target: A Mosco-convergent family of RGS-derived discrete Dirichlet forms on a fixed compact smooth Riemannian manifold, followed only later by spinorial and gauge-covariant extensions.
mosco_curved_program.warning: No curved RGS-Q6 convergence theorem is claimed by this index.
